mapper.sql: id, name, source, city, current_salary, expected_salary, gender, age, phone, email, highest_education, work_years, position, status, candidate_status, communication_status, intention, advantages, school, major, degree, education_start, education_end, company, work_position, work_start, work_end, work_description, imported_at, robot_name, avatar_color

where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR position LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR robot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

if.test: query.status != null and query.status != '' and query.status != 'all'

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM resumes
ORDER BY imported_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT status AS keyName, status AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM resumes GROUP BY status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resumes ( name, source, city, current_salary, expected_salary, gender, age, phone, email, highest_education, work_years, position, status, candidate_status, communication_status, intention, advantages, school, major, degree, education_start, education_end, company, work_position, work_start, work_end, work_description, imported_at, robot_name, avatar_color ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{source}, #{city}, #{currentSalary}, #{expectedSalary}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{highestEducation}, #{workYears}, #{position}, #{status}, #{candidateStatus}, #{communicationStatus}, #{intention}, #{advantages}, #{school}, #{major}, #{degree}, #{educationStart}, #{educationEnd}, #{company}, #{workPosition}, #{workStart}, #{workEnd}, #{workDescription}, COALESCE(#{importedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{robotName}, #{avatarColor} )
mapper.update: UPDATE resumes SET name = #{name}, source = #{source}, city = #{city}, current_salary = #{currentSalary}, expected_salary = #{expectedSalary}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, highest_education = #{highestEducation}, work_years = #{workYears}, position = #{position}, status = #{status}, candidate_status = #{candidateStatus}, communication_status = #{communicationStatus}, intention = #{intention}, advantages = #{advantages}, school = #{school}, major = #{major}, degree = #{degree}, education_start = #{educationStart}, education_end = #{educationEnd}, company = #{company}, work_position = #{workPosition}, work_start = #{workStart}, work_end = #{workEnd}, work_description = #{workDescription}, robot_name = #{robotName}, avatar_color = #{avatarColor} WHERE id = #{id}
